entry.description: `TelnetAppender` handles each accepted connection on a fresh stack. Since 3.0.0 a connection already waiting was handled inside the callback of the one before it, so clients that kept reconnecting nested callbacks on one thread (ANT-2026-VW2B0UOQ, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
